name: devanshs-page
description: Run the whole site with npm + Docker. No Maven or Java needed on your machine.

scripts.dev:api: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build api-dev
scripts.dev:web: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.backup: docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U devansh devansh
